items.sentence: I'd rather stay in than go out tonight.
items.translation: 我今晚宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。
explanations:
`would rather do A than do B` = 宁愿 A 也不 B。常见错误：
• "I'd rather **to** stay" → rather 后接原形
• "rather than **going** out" → than 后接与 stay 平行的原形 go out
`stay in` = 待在家（反义 go out）。
`tonight` 时间副词不加介词。

sentenceAudio.text: I'd rather stay in than go out tonight.

items.sentence: I'm looking for an apartment near the university.
items.translation: 我在找大学附近的公寓。
explanations:
找房用语。`look for` = 寻找（过程），`find` = 找到（结果）。常见错误：
• "I **looking for**" → 进行时缺 be 动词
• "I look for" → 一般现在时表习惯，当下找房用进行时

`an apartment` — apartment 以元音音素开头用 an。常见错误：
• "a apartment" → 元音前必须 an

`near the university` = 大学附近。常见错误：
• "near to the university" → near 直接接地点不加 to
• "nearby the university" → nearby 多作形容词/副词

sentenceAudio.text: I'm looking for an apartment near the university.

items.sentence: How much is the rent for this apartment?
items.translation: 这套公寓的租金是多少？
explanations:
问租金。`how much` 问不可数/价格，`how many` 问可数数量。常见错误：
• "How much **are** the rent" → rent 不可数用 is
• "How many is the rent" → 问钱用 how much

`the rent for` = 为……付的租金。常见错误：
• "the rent of" → of/for 混用，此处 for 表用途
• 漏 the → 特指这套房要加 the

`this apartment` — this 接单数。常见错误：
• "this apartments" → this 后不加 s

sentenceAudio.text: How much is the rent for this apartment?

items.sentence: Does the rent include the utilities?
items.translation: 房租包含水电燃气这些费用吗？
explanations:
看房必问。`utilities` 指水电燃气网费等，通常用复数。常见错误：
• "Does the rent **includes**" → does 后动词用原形
• "Do the rent" → rent 第三人称单数，助动词用 does
`include` = 包含。

`the utilities` — 各项杂费合称。常见错误：
• "the utility" → 泛指全部杂费用复数

sentenceAudio.text: Does the rent include the utilities?

items.sentence: I need to sign a one-year lease.
items.translation: 我需要签一份一年期的租约。
explanations:
签约用语。`sign a lease` = 签租约。常见错误：
• "I need **signing**" → need 后接 to do
• "I need to signed" → to 后动词原形

`a one-year lease` — 复合形容词 one-year 用单数加连字符，作定语。常见错误：
• "one-year **lease**" 丢了 a
• "a one-year **leases**" → 单数租约不加 s
`lease` = 租约（美式常用 lease/rental agreement）。

sentenceAudio.text: I need to sign a one-year lease.

items.sentence: I can't wait to move into my new place.
items.translation: 我迫不及待要搬进新家了。
explanations:
`can't wait to do sth` = 迫不及待做某事。常见错误：
• "I can't **waiting** to" → 固定 can't wait to + 原形
• "I don't wait to" → 没有这个说法

`move into` = 搬进（新居）。常见错误：
• "move in **to** my place" → move in 后直接接地点也可，move into 是完整短语
• "move to" → 表搬到某城市/国家，搬进具体房子用 into
`place` 口语中指「住处」。

sentenceAudio.text: I can't wait to move into my new place.

items.sentence: Do you still have the apartment for rent?
explanations:
租房电话常用语。`still` 表「仍然」，放助动词后。常见错误：
• "Are you still **have**" → have 是实义动词，疑问用 Do you have
• "Do you still **has**" → do 后原形
`the apartment` 特指那套。

`for rent` = 出租中（美式；英式 to let）。常见错误：
• "for renting" → 固定搭配 for rent
• "for a rent" → 多冠词

sentenceAudio.text: Do you still have the apartment for rent?

items.sentence: I'd like to open a savings account.
explanations:
银行业务。`open an account` = 开户。常见错误：
• "I like to open" → 表喜好，开卡要用 would like to
• "I'd like opening" → would like 后接 to do

`a savings account` — savings 用复数形式作定语（checking account 同理）。常见错误：
• "a saving account" → 固定 savings account
• "an savings" → savings 虽以 s 开头但音素 /s/ 前用 a
`account` 账户。

sentenceAudio.text: I'd like to open a savings account.

items.sentence: Could you tell me today's exchange rate?
items.translation: 你能告诉我今天的汇率吗？
explanations:
银行换汇用语。`Could you tell me...` = 比 Can you 更礼貌。常见错误：
• "Could you **told** me" → could 后原形
• "Could you to tell me" → 情态动词后直接原形

`today's` = 今天的，名词所有格表时间。常见错误：
• "today exchange rate" → 缺 's
• "todays" → 所有格要加撇号
`exchange rate` = 汇率。

sentenceAudio.text: Could you tell me today's exchange rate?

items.sentence: How much would it cost to send this to China?
items.translation: 把这个寄到中国要多少钱？
explanations:
邮局寄件问价。`How much would it cost to...` = ……要花多少钱。常见错误：
• "How many would" → 钱用 how much
• "What would it cost" → 也可以，但 how much 最常用
`it cost` — would 后用动词原形 cost（过去式也是 cost）。

`to send this to China` — send sth to + 地点。常见错误：
• "send this **for** China" → 搭配 send to
• "to sent" → to 后原形

sentenceAudio.text: How much would it cost to send this to China?

items.sentence: I'd like to get a haircut, please.
explanations:
理发店进门第一句。`get a haircut` = 理发。常见错误：
• "get **haircut**" → 漏 a
• "I'd like **cutting**" → would like to + 原形
• "cut my hair" → 也可以，但 get a haircut 是地道说法
美发店常见对话：How would you like it?（想怎么剪？）/ Just a trim, please.（稍微修一下）

sentenceAudio.text: I'd like to get a haircut, please.

items.sentence: Could you trim my beard a little?
items.translation: 你能帮我把胡子修短一点吗？
explanations:
`trim` = 修剪（不是全剃）。常见错误：
• "Could you **trimmed**" → could 后原形
• "cut off my beard" → 那是全剃掉，修短用 trim

`a little` = 一点点。常见错误：
• "a little **bit**" → 也可说 a little bit，但 a little 已够
• 注意 a little 修饰不可数

sentenceAudio.text: Could you trim my beard a little?

items.sentence: Could you take a little off the top?
items.translation: 能把头顶稍微剪短点吗？
explanations:
理发店高频句。`take a little off the top` = 头顶剪短一点。常见错误：
• "take a little **of** the top" → 固定 off the top
• "take off the top" → 少了 a little 程度
理发店其他说法：Make it shorter on the sides.（两侧短一点）

sentenceAudio.text: Could you take a little off the top?

items.sentence: I go to the gym twice a week.
explanations:
表达频率。`twice a week` = 每周两次（once 一次 / twice 两次 / three times 三次）。常见错误：
• "two times a week" → 也可以但 twice 更地道
• "twice every week" → a week 更常用

`go to the gym` — 固定搭配，gym 前要 the。常见错误：
• "go to gym" → 漏 the

sentenceAudio.text: I go to the gym twice a week.

items.sentence: I'm really out of shape these days.
items.translation: 我最近身体状况真的很差。
explanations:
`out of shape` = 身材走样/体能差，反义 in shape。常见错误：
• "out of **the** shape" → 固定短语不加 the
• "my shape is bad" → 中式，直接用 out of shape
`these days` = 最近/这些天，常配现在时或现在完成。

sentenceAudio.text: I'm really out of shape these days.

items.sentence: The Wi-Fi keeps dropping in my room.
items.translation: 我房间的无线网络老是断。
explanations:
酒店/租房网络抱怨。`keep doing` = 一直/老是做。常见错误：
• "keeps **to drop**" → keep 接 doing
• "the Wi-Fi is drop" → 现在进行时是 is dropping
`drop` = 掉线（信号中断）。同义：cut out。

sentenceAudio.text: The Wi-Fi keeps dropping in my room.

items.sentence: Could I borrow your charger for a sec?
items.translation: 我能借用一下你的充电器吗？
explanations:
`borrow` = 借入（别人给你），`lend` = 借出（你给别人）。常见错误：
• "Could I **lend** your charger" → 借入用 borrow
• "borrow your charger **to** me" → 语序错
`for a sec` = for a second 口语缩略，表短暂借用。

sentenceAudio.text: Could I borrow your charger for a sec?

items.sentence: My phone is running out of battery.
explanations:
`run out of` = 用完/耗尽。常见错误：
• "is running out **off**" → 是 out of
• "my phone is out of battery" → 也可，running out of 表「正在耗尽」
口语同义：My phone is dying. / It's almost dead.

sentenceAudio.text: My phone is running out of battery.

explanations:
`I've got` 是英式/口语里表「有」的常用说法，等于 I have。常见错误：
• "I've get" → got 是过去分词，不能换成原形
• "I got dandruff" → 美式口语也这么说，但强调当下状态用 I've got

`dandruff` 是不可数名词，不加 s、不加 a。常见错误：
• "a dandruff" → 不可数
• "dandruffs" → 没有复数形式

祈使句直接用动词原形开头。常见错误：
• "Trying some shampoo" → 祈使句不带动名词
• "Try to some shampoo" → try to 后面要接动词

`shampoo` 是不可数名词，用 some 修饰。常见错误：
• "a shampoo" → 说「一瓶洗发水」才用 a bottle of shampoo

`What's` = What is，问价格。常见错误：
• "Whats" → 少了撇号
• "How much the rent?" → 更完整的问法是 How much is the rent?
`rent` 表房租，可作名词也可作动词（rent a place）。

报价时省略货币单位（300 dollars a week）。常见错误：
• "300 in a week" → 表频率不加 in
• "300 every week" → 也对，但 a week 更简洁
`a week` 在这里 = per week，表费率。同义：300 weekly. / 300 per week.

`get some fresh air` 就是「出去透透气」。常见错误：
• "Get some fresh airs" → air 不可数，不加 s
• "Get some fresh water" → 那是淡水，fresh air 才是空气
同类：take a walk / get some sun，都属「出门活动」这一族。

`get some sun` 是「晒太阳」最地道的口语说法。常见错误：
• "Get some suns" → sun 不可数
• sun 与 son 同音 /sʌn/，听写时靠上下文区分
相关：get some sunshine（更强调暖阳）、get a tan（晒黑）。

`groceries` 指超市买回来的食材、日用品，习惯用复数。常见错误：
• "Get some grocery" → 一般用复数 groceries
• 拼写别丢 c：gro**c**eries，不是 groseries
美式也说 get some food / pick up some stuff；英式常说 do the shopping。

grammar.pos: 固定短语 take a walk

explanations:
`take a walk` 是「去走走、散步」的固定搭配。常见错误：
• "Take walk" → 缺少 a
• "Go a walk" → 动词用 take 或 have，不用 go
同义：go for a walk / take a stroll（更悠闲）。

`read` 现在式读 /riːd/，过去式拼写相同但读 /red/。常见错误：
• 别写成 "Look a book"（look 要接 at）
• "Read book" → 可数名词单数前要加 a
相关：read to me（读给我听）/ read aloud（朗读）

音乐、灯光都用 `put on` 表示「打开、放上」。常见错误：
• "Open the music" → 中文说开音乐，英文用 put on
• "Put on some musics" → music 不可数
相关：play some music / turn up the music（把音乐调大）

`smell` 表「闻」时是及物动词。常见错误：
• 说一片花丛用复数 flowers 更自然
• smell 还能作系动词：It smells good.（闻起来很香）
相关：take a deep breath（深呼吸）/ stop and smell the roses（享受生活）

液体用量词 `a glass of`。常见错误：
• "Have a wine" → 一杯酒要说 a glass of wine
• "Have a glass wine" → 少了 of
相关：a cup of tea（一杯茶）/ a bottle of beer（一瓶啤酒）

`nice food` 泛指好吃的；food 泛指时不可数。常见错误：
• "Have some nice foods" → 泛指用不可数形式
• "Eat some nice food" 也行，但 have 在招待语境更自然
相关：treat yourself（犒劳一下自己）/ have a nice meal
